free_tier_limits: Publicly accessible under CC BY 4.0, but the REST API is currently paused. When available, fair use is limited to 5 API calls per 1-minute period.
rate_limits: 5 API calls per 1-minute period under the Fair Use Policy; the REST API is currently paused.
description: SoilGrids is ISRIC's global digital soil-mapping system, providing modeled soil-property maps at 250 m resolution across six standard depth intervals, with quantified prediction uncertainty. Its beta REST API v2.0 is currently paused with no estimated restoration date; ISRIC recommends WMS, WCS, WebDAV, or Google Earth Engine for current access.
resolution_notes: free_tier_limits: corrected; ISRIC says the API is paused and otherwise limited to 5 calls per minute: https://docs.isric.org/globaldata/soilgrids/SoilGrids_faqs_02.html. rate_limits: corrected to the explicit 5-calls-per-minute policy at the same URL. description: corrected to include 250 m resolution, six depths, uncertainty, and the current pause: https://docs.isric.org/globaldata/soilgrids/index.html. The pause is temporary rather than a declared shutdown, so status is degraded.
